# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want participation in Ignite to be harassment-free for everyone, regardless
of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity
and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status,
nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and
orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good intent and critique ideas, not people.
- Give actionable feedback, ideally with a reproduction or benchmark.
- Accept that the project is early-stage and that not every request can be
  implemented immediately.
- Respect maintainers' time: search before opening issues, keep reports focused.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, threats or discriminatory language.
- Sexualised language or imagery, or unwelcome attention.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Deliberate disruption, spam, or bad-faith arguing.
- Dismissing reports of bugs or accessibility problems without investigation.

## Scope

This applies in all project spaces: issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews,
chat and any event where you represent the project.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close threads, or temporarily or permanently
ban contributors for behaviour that violates this code. Reports can be sent
privately to the maintainers through the repository's security/contact channel.
Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical.

## Attribution

This code is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
